# ResearchTree

> Every Git branch is an experiment and every pull request is its lab note. ResearchTree draws a repository's `research` branch, its version tags (`research/v1`, `research/v2`, ...) and its `experiment/*` pull requests as a tree, and reads the record back as typed Python objects for coding agents. GitHub is the only data store.

- Viewer: https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/ (sign in with GitHub; `?repo=owner/name` opens a repository)
- Demo project: https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/?repo=DarkPyonix/researchtree-demo
- Source: https://github.com/DarkPyonix/researchtree (Apache-2.0)
- Python package: `pip install researchtree` (CLI `researchtree`, API `import researchtree as rt`)
- VS Code extension: `darkpyonix.researchtree`
- Agent skill: `researchtree skill install` writes SKILL.md into `.claude/skills/` or `.agents/skills/`

The guide below is written in Korean.

## Recording rules

- [Branches](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/rules/branches): `research` root, one `experiment/<name>` branch per experiment
- [Pull requests and the YAML block](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/rules/pull-requests): `parent`, `hypothesis`, `change`, `metrics`, `status`, `tags`, `claims`, `started`, `ended`
- [Research version tags](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/rules/versions): `research/vN`, and `researchtree release` for cleaning up finished branches
- [Tree rules](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/rules/tree-rules): how status, parents and versions are resolved
- [Intent- and spec-driven development](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/rules/spec): spec-driven development adapted to research (a spec change is a hypothesis; adoption decides whether it enters the spec), `INTENT.md` claims, `SPEC.md`, `.researchtree`, section ids and includes

## Using it

- [Introduction](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/introduction)
- [Preparing a repository](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/repo-setup)
- [Logging from a training script](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/tracking): `rt.log`, `rt.set`, `rt.conclude`
- [Agent memory](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/memory): `rt.load()`, `researchtree memory`, `researchtree spec`
- [Local server](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/local): `researchtree serve`
- [Security and privacy](https://darkpyonix.github.io/researchtree/guide/guide/security)
